text:
deploy-bot: Safety valve opened for release v3.7.2 in hosted-usw (p95 latency +32% over baseline, error-rate +1.8%)

alice: saw the alert, holding all further traffic shifts. tagging @ben and @carla. :warning:

ben: on it. is this a full rollback or staged unwind? any customer-impacting errors in logs?

deploy-bot: Recent events: 
- 3067891234 deploy start v3.7.2
- 3067891240 traffic split 100% -> 60% new
- 3067891260 safety_valve_trip: latency_threshold

carla: logs show a memory spike on scorer worker around 3067891255, OOMs occasionally. not seeing request errors yet, mostly latency/timeouts.

mira: recommend staged unwind per runbook: reduce to 30% -> 10% -> 0 within change window, then pin to last stable. gives us telemetry between steps.

alice: agree. need comms for customers on Dedicated pools and any large tenants. @sre-oncall can you confirm we have capacity to absorb traffic back to 3.6.9?

sre-oncall: checking capacity now. should be fine on reserved pools, may need to temporarily scale hosted-usw workers. will post numbers in 2m.

ben: action plan I propose: 
1) execute staged unwind: traffic 60% -> 30% (exec now)
2) wait 5m, check p95 & errors
3) if still bad, 30% -> 10% then evaluate
4) pin pool to 3.6.9 if repeated regressions and notify customers

ben: running command to scale traffic slice: ```sh
redwoodctl traffic-slice set --pool=hosted-usw --version=3.7.2 --percent=30
```

deploy-bot: Command accepted, applying changes...

deploy-bot: Traffic for 3.7.2 in hosted-usw now 30% (timestamp 3067891265)

carla: monitoring traces now, p95 dropped slightly but still +18% over baseline. collecting flame graphs.

alice: keep support loop updated. @carla draft a short customer note mentioning rollback possibility; @mira prepare release-note delta marking v3.7.2 as paused.

mira: draft ready, will post to #release-notes and attach to support ticket. short blurb: "We've paused rollout of v3.7.2 due to increased latency on us-west; rolling back to 3.6.9 for affected pools while we investigate."

sre-oncall: hosted-usw autoscale request queued +2 workers, ETA 90s. if we need to keep traffic, that might mitigate but prefer unwind to be safe.
